title: The day before launch - Starship Flight 13 - Countdown to Launch

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
Following Booster 20's impressive static fire test, SpaceX has set July 16 as the earliest launch date for Flight 13. The Booster, along with Ship 40, is currently at the Production Site waiting to roll out to Pad 2.
